builder.protocol_deviation: elastic_constants cases strain a FIXED builder-supplied lattice (reference/guess a0), not each model's own relaxed cell as the local run_candidate_campaign.py does. Cells are labeled protocol=fixed_lattice and stay out of headline Cij claims until the candidate_statics runner row lands (packet GAP-1).

round1_targets.notes: Round-1 candidate targets for the unbiased raw-MLIP vs Lupine-enhanced-MLIP accuracy campaign. All reference values web-verified 2026-07-13 (see per-value source/caveat). kind is one of: exp | DFT-PBE | other. null = genuinely unfindable/unverifiable this session (do not invent). Companion prereg: docs/plans/2026-07-13-unbiased-accuracy-campaign.md.

a0.caveat: Ordered L10 tetrataenite is tetragonal (a=3.582, c=3.607); the DISORDERED fcc solid solution simulated here has a cubic parameter in the 3.58-3.60 A range. We score against a=3.582 A with +/-0.01 A convention uncertainty flagged.
a0.source: Taenite/tetrataenite (Fe-Ni 50:50) meteorite XRD: 'Tetragonal Lattice of Tetrataenite (Ordered Fe-Ni, 50-50) from 4 Meteorites', Phys. Scr. 23 (1981) 301 (Albertsen), a = b = 3.582 A, c = 3.607 A

b0.caveat: Verified from the article abstract/record (OUCI mirror). Cross-check: Wu et al. Acta Mater. 81 (2014) Table II gives G=62 GPa, nu=0.34 for FeNi -> B = 173 GPa. Consistent. Note Fe-Ni near 50:50 has Invar-adjacent magnetoelastic softness; temperature/field convention matters.
b0.source: R.S. Singh, S. Guruswamy, 'Elastic constants of equiatomic Fe-Ni Invar alloy single crystal', AIP Advances 13 (2023) 115112, doi:10.1063/5.0174535 (bulk modulus from RUS on [001] Fe-50Ni single crystal, no applied field)

hp-csgei3.a0_null_reason: Cubic (Pm-3m) CsGeI3 exists only above ~550 K (transition confirmed in multiple sources incl. arXiv:2603.11844 context; RT phase is R3m per Thiele et al. 1987). A numeric experimental HIGH-T cubic lattice parameter could not be verified this session (DFT cubic a ~ 6.0 A is reported but attribution unpinned). lattice_guess 6.05 A is an unreferenced initialization value only; a0 scoring for CsGeI3 is DEFERRED unless a Thiele 1987 (Z. anorg. allg. Chem. 545, 148) value is pinned before freeze.
hp-csgei3.mp_id_caveat: mp-28377 is the trigonal R3m room-temperature ground state, not the cubic phase; a verified MP id for the cubic polymorph was not found this session.

b0.caveat: Athermal 0 K cubic cell; internal consistency (C11+2C12)/3 = 18.9 GPa = their B. Note RT ground state is rhombohedral R3m (Ge off-centering ~0.17 A along [111]); cubic is a >550 K phase.
b0.source: Roknuzzaman et al., Sci. Rep. 7 (2017) 14025, Table 1 (verified from PMC5656601)

c11.caveat: Athermal 0 K cubic cell; cubic phase is dynamically-adjacent to the R3m distortion, so MLIP relaxations may fall into the rhombohedral well - record which minimum was scored.
